description: A toothbrush sits in a white paper cup on the right side of the table, and a small toothpaste tube is on the tabletop nearby. The right hand reaches to the cup, lifts the toothbrush out and lays it horizontally on the table, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube, opens it, and squeezes a line of paste onto the toothbrush bristles; the right hand then lifts the toothbrush and puts it back into the cup.
